scene: Three neighbors spend a cloudy spring morning looking after a shared rooftop vegetable garden.
setting: the flat roof of an old apartment building with raised wooden planters and the city spreading out beyond a low brick parapet

characters.action: digs a small hole for seedlings in a planter
waters lettuce with a dented tin watering can
rests on a folding stool under a striped canvas awning

props: raised wooden planters with lettuce and tomato vines
a striped canvas awning on poles
distant apartment blocks and a radio tower
lights: soft diffused daylight through thin clouds
